### Show more
Clamped text with a button that shows the rest, and hides itself when the text already fits.

Component ID: `show-more`

[Component documentation](https://www.expressivecss.com/show-more.html.md) · [Repository source](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/blob/master/docs/src/pages/show-more.astro) · [Matching tag](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/tree/v0.15.0)

#### Selection and adaptation

Runtime ownership: `auto-init`. No dedicated entry in the reviewed Google component inventory.

Example: A product card clamps its description to three lines with a Show more text button; a terms-of-service page with headed sections uses an accordion instead.

#### Material mapping

Relationship: none. Web extension; no dedicated entry was observed in the reviewed current M3 component inventory.

Upstream: web-extension-inventory-reviewed (2026-10-25); [evidence](https://m3.material.io/components).

Requirements and boundaries: design reference web-extensions-review. The inventory page renders client-side, so this review relies on the 2026-09-13 inventory review. Full visual parity and spoken output unverified.

Support (2026-10-25, `llm.md#show-more`): A .show-more holding text with a line-clamp-1, -2 or -3 class and a <button type="button">; the button sets aria-expanded and aria-controls, shows the full text, reads "Show less" while it is open (i18n.showLess or data-show-less), and hides while the clamped text fits, checking again on resize, after web fonts load and on blur.

Web adaptation: The component unclamps with inline -webkit-line-clamp and line-clamp, because the utilities layer and prefixed clamp classes beat any component rule. A ResizeObserver on the text and document.fonts.ready run the fit check, scrollHeight against clientHeight with 1px for Firefox's rounding.

Known boundary: Toggling, the fit check across widths, fractional line heights and window-size prefixes, the focused-button cases, a web-font swap, labels, events and destroy() are checked in a browser or jsdom; spoken output is unverified. Find-in-page does not open clamped text, a font that starts loading after document.fonts.ready has settled is not caught until the next resize, and an icon-only button keeps its aria-label while open.

Full parity remains unassessed. [Capability evidence](../references/capability-roadmap.md#show-more).

#### Contract

A `.show-more` holds the text, with a `line-clamp-1`, `line-clamp-2` or `line-clamp-3` class, and a `<button type="button">` whose text is the collapsed label. `AutoInit()` starts every one. The component points the button at the text with `aria-controls`, adding an id to the text when it has none, and sets `aria-expanded`. Activating the button shows the full text and changes the label to "Show less"; activating it again clamps the text and puts the author's label back. Only the button's last text outside an `aria-hidden="true"` element changes, so an icon keeps its glyph. An icon-only button named by `aria-label` has no text to change: it keeps its name, and only `aria-expanded` says the text is open. Prefer a visible label.

While the clamped text fits, the button gets `hidden`, so it is neither seen nor reached by Tab. The component checks again when the text's size changes and once web fonts have loaded, so `line-clamp-3 expanded:line-clamp-none` hides the button from Expanded windows up. A focused button stays until focus moves on, and open text keeps its button. Expanding sets `-webkit-line-clamp` and `line-clamp` inline, because a prefixed clamp class would beat `line-clamp-none`. The text opens and closes at once, without a transition.

The clamp classes set `display`, so the text cannot also be a flex or grid container; put the clamp on a child. The browser's find-in-page does not open clamped text, so a match in the hidden lines is not shown until the person opens it.

#### Syntax

```html
<div class="show-more">
  <p class="line-clamp-3">A long product description that runs well past three lines...</p>
  <button type="button" class="text">Show more</button>
</div>
```

#### Options

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onOpen` | Function | `null` | Called after the full text shows. |
| `onClose` | Function | `null` | Called after the text is clamped again. |
| `i18n` | Object | `{ showLess: 'Show less' }` | The button's label while the text is open. `data-show-less` on the button sets it for one control. |

#### Methods

- `.open()`: Shows the full text.
- `.close()`: Clamps the text again.
- `.destroy()`: Removes the listeners, clamps the text without an event, and restores the button's label, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` and `hidden`, and the text's id.

#### Rules

- `show-more-needs-a-button`: Give a .show-more a <button type="button"> child. A <span> or <div> with role="button" is not operable from the keyboard without script, and a <button> without type="button" submits the form it sits in.
- `show-more-needs-clamped-text`: Give a .show-more a child with line-clamp-1, line-clamp-2 or line-clamp-3. That is the text the button expands; without it the component does nothing.
